name: Greater Vital Spark · Earth
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 5.08-block radius for 18 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 4.5 ❤ lightning + 3 ❤ earth (lightning ×2 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Charge 126: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 12 targets in a row, jumps up to 7 blocks, 4.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Growth: up to 10 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Brittle (earth damage ×2) for 9 s
self_description:
